In this case, A' represents the event of disliking blue, B represents the event of liking green, and A' ∩ B represents the event of disliking blue and liking green. Now, we can plug these values into the conditional probability formula: P(A' | B) = P(A' ∩ B) / P(B) = 23% / 45% ≈ 0.5111.
